column3: Kuroneko Route · Overworking, Lack of Sleep and Anxiety
...I have a question for you.
...What is it?
...Why... Why are you so concerned about me?
Why do you ask?
Isn't this just... someone else's problem to you after all?
Of course I would be concerned!
How many times have I said that I'm worried about you?
...That's just you being nosy.
Even if it's being nosy to you, I'm really worried about you. So worried that I don't even know what to say...
My... this isn't really an answer.
Although it can't be counted as an answer... it can be said that it's very much your way of doing things.
...To say "someone else's problem"... You're really...
What...?
If you really think of it that way, even I'll get disappointed.
Really...
Well, you don't really mean what you're saying, I know that much.
Heh... Good grief, what do you really know about me?
Even though you're very stubborn, you do care for your friends. I know this well. That's why I know you aren't being serious.
I'm amazed... To say that you understand others with that alone...
I'll just say something honest...
You have my heartfelt thanks for being worried about me...
I see...
But I don't understand your feelings.
My... feelings?
Yes. What were you really thinking when you're trying to stop me? And what's the origin of that thought? What do you gain from stopping me?
You don't get it?
Yes. I don't understand whatever it is that you're doing.
You... You're really being a fool here.
...That's true. Perhaps we're both fools, you and I. Too foolish to be saved.
Hey, even me?
Isn't that a given?
So you admit you're a fool too.
I don't intend to pretend I'm a wise person at the very least. At any rate...
...It's fine, even if you don't get it. I didn't think that you would understand it.
...I see. Not... troubling people, that's a good thing.
However, don't push yourself.
That...I refuse.
Why?
It's because I'm a creator.
...Huh? What does that mean...?
You can't create an excellent product if you don't experience the hardships of a creator. I'm not a genius, so I'm destined to walk on this thorny path.
I don't know what you're talking about... How did we even get onto this topic?
Creations are often accompanied by huge hardships...
It's just like walking in the dark, there is no such thing as a definite answer. Although some paths are indeed better than others, always close by us.
And to continuously look for those is our purpose, as creators.
Even so, surely you don't have to push yourself to that extent?
No, that is necessary. You won't understand since you're not a creator.
Guh... I can't say anything if you put it that way...
You weren't so exhausted when you were working on that game the previous time...
The present and the past, they're completely different.
...This is being too hard on yourself...
It must be done for this level of work, there are many others who would give their lives for their works too.
It won't kill me if I force myself to this degree, right?
Even though that's the case...
It's fine like this. Because this is what I've wished for.
I'll definitely create a good piece of work when I experience such hardships...
That is what I firmly believe in...
Isn't that a wrong assumption? Just because you're going through tough times, you're using that reason to comfort yourself?
Who knows? However, it's true that many creators had walked on the same path.
And so, I will walk upon this path too.
What's with that?! Creation or whatever, is there only suffering in creating?!
No, I don't just feel pain. There's the many types of joy I'm experiencing too, which is why I'm able to endure this suffering.
Endure... Are you training to be a monk?
I guess... This might even come close to it.
It's just suffering for different objectives. They devote themselves to the Gods, and I devote myself to my masterpieces. That's the only difference.
This isn't working... I guess I really can't stop her...
Say... Just a little, any bit will do... is there anything I can help out with?
If you put it that way... all the more reason I can't just leave you alone...
...I think there's nothing.
So this pain shall be mine and mine alone. This is my creation, so that's why, this pain is something that only belongs to me...
Why are you keeping that all to yourself?
I can have the sense of pride precisely because there's that sense of hardship. Because that's what I produced.
Can't you do something else for that sense of pride!?
I want proof. An absolute proof for my transcending work.
...Do you seriously think about it that way?
You're putting that face on again... I'm serious.
....You're serious?
Heh... Obviously. No matter how much you worry about me, it's pointless. Did you finally get it?
Our kind is greedy. To the point that ordinary people think of it as madness.
That's why you won't stop?
Yes, exactly.
